name: Ask Odin
description: Send a request to Odin, this Brightside's administrator, for a change that needs administrator rights — integrations and adapters, venue settings, users, access grants, or repairs to your own configuration. Odin decides whether to do it, ask the owner through their Inbox, or decline; he sees who is asking. Best-effort synchronous: waits up to `timeout` milliseconds (default 30000) for his answer and returns it; otherwise returns a snapshot {id, status: STARTED, address, sessionId} — poll grid_job_result(id=<that id>, timeout=<ms>) for the outcome, which may take as long as the owner takes to answer him. Set timeout=0 for pure async.

request.description: What you want changed and why it serves the owner — self-contained, in the owner's words where possible. Up to 4000 characters.

context.description: Optional: what you tried, what failed, or what the owner said. Up to 8000 characters.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for Odin's answer. Default 30000; 0 returns a snapshot at once; at most 300000.

output.description: Odin's outcome — what he did, declined, or asked the owner — or a {id, status: STARTED, address, sessionId} snapshot to poll.
